events.subtitle: The Legacy Tour
events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents John Fogerty and Steve Winwood on September 15, 2026 at 7:30 PM at the Filene Center in Vienna, Virginia. Gates open at 6:00 PM. The venue bills the co-headline run as The Legacy Tour. Steve Winwood's official site independently lists the September 15 Wolf Trap date. Wolf Trap's exact event page links to its authorized Tickets.com purchase destination.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the pairing rather than a generic classic-rock package. Fogerty carries one of the most identifiable American roots-rock songbooks still led by its original voice, while Winwood brings the Hammond, soul and jazz-rock lineage that runs through Spencer Davis, Traffic and his solo work. Putting those two histories on the same local bill gives the night more musical range than a routine legacy tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for it in the DMV. The one-night local pairing is strong enough to justify a reasonable regional drive, while the multi-city tour means there is no need to rebuild a larger trip around this stop alone.
en.listen_before: John Fogerty — Legacy: the Creedence Clearwater Revival years (John's Version); Steve Winwood — Arc of a Diver

es.why_it_matters: Lo importante es la combinación, no un paquete genérico de rock clásico. Fogerty carga uno de los cancioneros más reconocibles del roots rock estadounidense todavía en la voz que lo creó, mientras Winwood trae el Hammond, el soul y la línea jazz-rock que atraviesa Spencer Davis, Traffic y su carrera solista. Juntar esas dos historias en una misma noche local le da mucho más rango musical que una parada rutinaria de nostalgia.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente en el DMV. La combinación de una sola noche justifica un manejo regional razonable, pero al ser parte de una gira de varias ciudades no reconstruiría un viaje mayor sólo alrededor de esta parada.

en.why_it_matters: This is a more specific proposition than simply seeing a long-running Japanese pop artist at Blue Note. The shows sit directly against Chara's 35th debut anniversary, the club promises career-spanning and less-obvious repertoire, and the menus can change across the two nights. That combination turns the engagement into a compact retrospective of a distinctive voice in Japanese pop, soul and art-pop rather than a normal tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for a set if your Tokyo dates overlap, especially if the Japanese-pop thread of the trip matters. It is a strong city-night anchor without needing to displace a rarer master, premiere or one-off elsewhere in the itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es más específico que simplemente ver a una artista japonesa de larga trayectoria en Blue Note. Las funciones caen pegadas al aniversario 35 de su debut, el club promete repertorio de toda la carrera incluyendo canciones menos obvias y los menús pueden cambiar entre las dos noches. Así se vuelve una retrospectiva compacta de una voz muy particular del pop, soul y art-pop japonés, no una parada normal de gira.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio a un set si coincide con tus días en Tokio, sobre todo si el hilo de pop japonés importa dentro del viaje. Es una muy buena ancla para una noche en la ciudad sin desplazar una rareza mayor, un estreno o un one-off.

events.subtitle: directed by Scotty Barnhart
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents The Legendary Count Basie Orchestra directed by Scotty Barnhart for a seven-day residency on October 23-27 and October 30-31, 2026. Friday/weekday dates have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets; Saturday/Sunday dates have 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets. The venue notes that the orchestra entered a new decade after its 90th-anniversary run in 2025 and highlights its current 18-member lineup and the Grammy-nominated 2025 album Basie Rocks!.

en.why_it_matters: The Basie Orchestra is a living transmission line for one of jazz's foundational rhythmic languages: the light-but-relentless swing, riff architecture and ensemble discipline matter as much as the name on the marquee. The current band is active enough to keep recording rather than merely reconstructing a historical book, which makes the residency worth having on the RADAR even though Blue Note Tokyo hosts it regularly.
en.trip_verdict: Worth knowing about and catching if a Tokyo evening is open, especially for big-band swing and jazz lineage. Seven nights plus the orchestra's recurring Blue Note history make it easy to fit into a trip rather than something that should displace a rarer anchor.
en.listen_before: Deborah Silver & The Count Basie Orchestra — Basie Rocks!

es.why_it_matters: La Basie Orchestra sigue siendo una línea viva de transmisión para uno de los lenguajes rítmicos fundacionales del jazz: el swing ligero pero implacable, la arquitectura de riffs y la disciplina del ensamble importan tanto como el nombre del cartel. La banda actual sigue grabando y no se limita a reconstruir un libro histórico, así que merece estar en el RADAR aunque Blue Note Tokyo la reciba con frecuencia.
es.trip_verdict: Vale tenerla presente y entrarle si queda una noche libre en Tokio, especialmente si te interesa big band, swing y genealogía del jazz. Las siete noches y su historial recurrente en Blue Note hacen que sea fácil acomodarla dentro del viaje sin desplazar una ancla más rara.
es.listen_before: Deborah Silver & The Count Basie Orchestra — Basie Rocks!
